earlier_scan.source_named: Stanley, Carol. Description phonologique et morphosyntaxique de la langue tikar; also 'Description phonologique du tikar (parler de Bankim)' — in Glottolog refs; no online copies found.

sources.citation: Hagège, Claude. 1969. Esquisse linguistique du tikar (Cameroun). Bibliothèque de la SELAF 11. Paris: Klincksieck/SELAF. 63 pp. — Rosetta Project excerpt pp. 23–25 (II. La langue tikar, A. Phonologie, 1. Les phonèmes)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Pages cover the consonant and vowel inventories, vowel length, tone on long vowels (ton haut-bas vs bas-haut), and low-toned syllabic nasals/liquids; the sketch's later prosody pages are not in the excerpt.

sources.citation: Stanley-Thorne, Carol. 1995. Noun Classes in Tikar. ERIC ED395504. 15 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; only a tone-marking note ('All unmarked tones in the data are phonologically non-low level tones') and discussion of low-toned syllabic nasal prefixes.

sources.citation: Hagège 1969, Rosetta Project excerpt of the morphosyntax pages (rosettaproject_tik_morsyn-1) and the 'Note sur les Tikar de Bankim et leur langue' (rosettaproject_tik_detail-1)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No mention of accent/stress; tone (ton haut/bas, bas-haut) referred to in verb morphology only.
